subject: [PATCH v4 00/11] Virtual Swap Space (Swap Table Edition)

reviews.author: Johannes Weiner
reviews.summary: Identified several issues with the original patch series and suggested improvements, including replacing the runtime sysctl with a cmdline parameter and refactoring swap-related memcg operations. Provided detailed feedback on specific technical concerns.

reviews.author: Nhat Pham
reviews.summary: Addressed several of the concerns raised by Johannes Weiner, including replacing the runtime sysctl with a cmdline parameter and refactoring swap-related memcg operations. Introduced debugfs counters for vswap usage and allocation rejection.

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch series introduces Virtual Swap Space (VSwap), a new swap space management system that allows for efficient allocation and deallocation of swap slots. VSwap is designed to handle the complexities of modern swap optimizations, such as zswap-backed and zero-filled pages. The patches refactor the swap memcg operations into separate get, record, charge, uncharge, and put helpers, and introduce debugfs counters for vswap usage and allocation rejection.
